Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?

questions.answer: i find the intro week very problematic. Way to much focus on drinking every day. I was stunned. I would prefer dividing the students by age instead of shared study-program. That would have made such a different to me as a 24-year-old.

questions.answer: Live with locals, it is okay to miss friends and familiy back home, do the best you can, but it is also okay to take a break sometimes.
